title: DreamMusicForge Universal Production Blueprint
description: Assembles the five already-implemented pipeline documents (Principle Kernel, Narrative + Emotional Architecture, Musical Architecture, Cinematic Architecture, Editorial Architecture) plus the remaining Universal Production Blueprint sections from the mission into a single package. Deliberately keeps three tiers separate rather than flattening them into one undifferentiated document -- see 'tiers' below -- because they carry different epistemic status, the same discipline this repo's source material (a video on the several unrelated meanings of 'dimension' in physics and math) argues for: don't let one word, or here one document, cover claims of different reliability without marking which is which.

embedded_documents.description: Tier 1: VERIFIED_STRUCTURED. Full instances of the five already-implemented, already-cross-validated documents. Not summarized or re-typed -- embedded whole, then re-validated by validate_full_chain() against every existing single-document and cross-document validator.

narrative_supplement.description: Tier 2: DESIGNED_FREE_TEXT. The Universal Production Blueprint sections that have no dedicated schema yet. Real and required, but not cross-checked the way tier 1 is -- do not treat these as equally verified.

reflection_and_legacy_statement.description: Must describe the work's intended afterlife in the audience's mind without stating the maxim outright -- consistent with the non-compulsion mission and the ending discipline already enforced in Editorial Architecture.

provider_specific_prompt_sets.description: Tier 3: NOT_YET_BUILT. The provider translation layer is unimplemented -- this section exists so the Blueprint's shape is complete, not to claim the layer works. build_status must be 'not_yet_built' with an empty prompts array until that engineering actually happens.

review_checklist.description: Exactly the eight Review Councils from the mission, each present exactly once.

contains.const: This kernel does not claim to guarantee any specific viewer belief, emotion, or decision.
